traits.name: known_scammer
traits.description: The address has a confirmed history of malicious activity, including scams, phishing, or other harmful behavior.

traits.name: blacklist
traits.description: The address appears on external or internal blacklist sources due to prior involvement in high‑risk or malicious activity.

traits.name: attack_money_target
traits.description: The address has received funds tied to exploits, wallet drainers, or other forms of attack‑related activity.

traits.name: fake_phishing_transfer
traits.description: The address appears in transaction histories involving transfers linked to scam activity or phishing‑related operations.
